sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Sleeper State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-20, 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-25)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (2027-06-08 and 07-13 alike): 20/30-amp sites $37, 50-amp sites $42; 2026 (Oct 20): $35 / $40. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park and forest campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($37 for 140 20/30-amp sites and $42 for 85 50-amp sites on 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13; $35 / $40 on 2026-10-20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/sleeper ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/sleeper ('There is 30- or 50-amp service available on each site') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (all 225 campsites 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'; 85 with 20/30/50 A; one 'Auxiliary' site with sewer is not a public campsite map), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Modern campground of 226 sites in three map sections (1-17/59-94/126-139, 18-58/95-125, 140-226), mostly generous and shaded by oaks and pines; four ADA sites at the west end; plus a mini cabin. On the booking site the 20/30-amp sites take trailers/RVs to 40 ft and the 50-amp sites to 50 ft and over.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/sleeper ('Number of sites: 226', 'Pull-through sites available') + midnrreservations.com resources (equipment to 'Trailer or RV up to 40'' on 140 sites and 'Trailer or RV over 50'' on 85), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The modern toilet/shower building closes after mid-October; vault toilets and water stay available.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/sleeper (Sleeper Modern Campground: 'Concession or store', 'Sanitation station', 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'WiFi'; 'The park's sanitation station is located near the campground office. There is potable water available and two lanes'; 'The modern toilet/shower building is closed after mid-October, but vault toilets and water are available'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/sleeper (Sleeper Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground under oaks and pines, across M-25/Port Austin Road from the Saginaw Bay (Lake Huron) day-use beach, reached by a pedestrian overpass bridge; the west end is nearer the beach. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site: 226 sites, 30/50 A on every site (85 with 50 A), electric only, pull-throughs, RVs to 40 ft (20/30 A sites) and 50+ ft (50 A sites), showers/flush and vault toilets/sanitation station with potable water, store, WiFi. Fees 35-40 (2026 table) -> 37-42 (2027 booking site; 2026 rates and the Recreation Passport in fees.note). Season (manual) left. Inherited window/15-night max not stated on the park page; left inherited. Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
